questions.question: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
questions.explanation: The INC was founded in 1885 by A.O. Hume.

questions.question: The deficiency of which vitamin causes scurvy?
questions.explanation: Scurvy is caused by a deficiency of Vitamin C.

questions.question: The Param Vir Chakra is awarded for:
questions.explanation: The Param Vir Chakra is India’s highest wartime gallantry award.

questions.question: Who was the last Governor-General of independent India?
questions.explanation: C. Rajagopalachari was the last and only Indian Governor-General.

questions.question: The "Gateway of India" is located in which city?
questions.explanation: The Gateway of India is in Mumbai.

questions.question: The Indus Valley Civilisation is also known as the:
questions.explanation: It is called the Harappan Civilisation after Harappa, its first excavated site.

questions.question: Which planet is known as the "Red Planet"?
questions.explanation: Mars looks red due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.question: Photosynthesis mainly takes place in the:
questions.explanation: Leaves contain chlorophyll where photosynthesis occurs.

questions.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in which city?
questions.explanation: It occurred at Amritsar on 13 April 1919.

questions.question: Which is the densest planet in the solar system?
questions.explanation: Earth is the densest planet in the solar system.

questions.question: The financial year in India runs from:
questions.explanation: India’s financial year is April to March.

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.

questions.question: The chemical symbol for gold is:
questions.explanation: Gold’s symbol Au comes from Latin "aurum".

questions.question: GST was implemented in India on:
questions.explanation: GST came into effect on 1 July 2017.

questions.question: Which line divides the Earth into Northern and Southern hemispheres?
questions.explanation: The Equator divides the Earth into two hemispheres.

questions.question: Which is the longest river flowing within India?
questions.explanation: The Ganga (~2,525 km) is the longest river within India.

questions.question: Sound cannot travel through:
questions.explanation: Sound needs a medium and cannot travel through a vacuum.

questions.question: Which blood group is known as the universal donor?
questions.explanation: O-negative is the universal donor blood group.

questions.question: The maximum strength of the Lok Sabha as per the Constitution is:
questions.explanation: The Constitution permits a maximum of 550 elected members in the Lok Sabha.

questions.question: The headquarters of the United Nations is in:
questions.explanation: The UN headquarters is in New York City.

questions.question: In which year was the Quit India Movement launched?
questions.explanation: It was launched on 8 August 1942.

questions.question: Mount Everest is located in which country?
questions.explanation: Mount Everest lies on the Nepal–China border, with its peak in Nepal.

questions.question: How many schedules are there in the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: The Constitution currently has 12 schedules.

questions.question: The Ranji Trophy is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Ranji Trophy is a domestic first-class cricket competition.

questions.question: Which part of the Constitution deals with Fundamental Duties?
questions.explanation: Fundamental Duties are in Part IVA (Article 51A), added by the 42nd Amendment.

questions.question: Which vitamin is produced when skin is exposed to sunlight?
questions.explanation: Sunlight triggers Vitamin D synthesis in the skin.

questions.question: Which disease is caused by a deficiency of iodine?
questions.explanation: Iodine deficiency causes goitre.

questions.question: Which international body is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland?
questions.explanation: The WHO is headquartered in Geneva.

questions.question: Which organ in the human body purifies blood?
questions.explanation: The kidneys filter and purify blood.

questions.question: The President of India is elected by:
questions.explanation: The President is elected by an electoral college of MPs and MLAs.

questions.question: The Rajya Sabha has a maximum strength of:
questions.explanation: The maximum strength of the Rajya Sabha is 250 members.

questions.question: In which year was the Reserve Bank of India established?
questions.explanation: The RBI was established in 1935.

questions.question: Which is the southernmost point of mainland India?
questions.explanation: Kanyakumari is the southernmost point of mainland India (Indira Point is the southernmost of Indian territory).

questions.question: The currency of the United Kingdom is the:
questions.explanation: The UK uses the Pound Sterling.

questions.question: Which river is the longest in the world?
questions.explanation: The Nile is generally regarded as the longest river in the world.

questions.question: Which is the largest state in India by area?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is the largest Indian state by area.

questions.question: The "Right to Education" was made a fundamental right by which amendment?
questions.explanation: The 86th Amendment (2002) added Article 21A — Right to Education.

questions.question: The hardest natural substance known is:
questions.explanation: Diamond is the hardest known natural substance.

questions.question: Who is the supreme commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.explanation: The President is the supreme commander of the armed forces.

questions.question: Which river is known as the "Sorrow of Bihar"?
questions.explanation: The Kosi river is called the "Sorrow of Bihar" due to flooding.

questions.question: Who founded the Arya Samaj?
questions.explanation: Swami Dayananda Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj in 1875.

questions.question: Who administers the oath of office to the President of India?
questions.explanation: The Chief Justice of India administers the oath to the President.

questions.question: Which amendment is known as the "Mini Constitution"?
questions.explanation: The 42nd Amendment (1976) is called the "Mini Constitution" for its sweeping changes.

questions.question: Who composed the song "Vande Mataram"?
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee wrote "Vande Mataram".

questions.question: How many members can the President nominate to the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: The President nominates 12 members to the Rajya Sabha for expertise in arts, science, etc.

questions.question: Which strait separates India from Sri Lanka?
questions.explanation: The Palk Strait separates India and Sri Lanka.

questions.question: Which day is celebrated as International Yoga Day?
questions.explanation: International Yoga Day is 21 June.

questions.question: What is 10% of 580?
Find the simple interest on ₹1400 at 12% per annum for 5 years.
Find the compound interest on ₹2000 at 10% per annum for 2 years.
An article costing ₹300 is sold for ₹330. Find the profit percentage.
An article costing ₹520 is sold at a 5% profit. Find the selling price.
Find the average of the first five multiples of 2.
questions.explanation: Multiples: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. Sum = 30. Average = 30/5 = 6.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 4 and their sum is 77. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 7. Each part = 77/7 = 11. Larger = 4 × 11 = 44.

questions.question: A train 120 m long crosses a pole in 6 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 10 days and B in 15 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/10 + 1/15 = 25/150. Time = 150/25 = 6 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 21 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
Find the value of √625.
After a 10% discount, an item costs ₹360. Find its marked price.
Find 50% of 20% of 1400.
Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 5 and their difference is 27. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 3 parts = 27, so each part = 9. Smaller = 2 × 9 = 18.

questions.question: A boat travels 51 km downstream in 3 hours. If the speed of the stream is 3 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 51/3 = 17 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 17 − 3 = 14 km/h.

questions.question: Find the value of ∛1000.
A train 240 m long crosses a platform 160 m long in 20 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
questions.explanation: Total distance = 240 + 160 = 400 m in 20 s = 20 m/s = 72 km/h.

questions.question: What is 20% of 360?
Find the simple interest on ₹1500 at 4% per annum for 3 years.
Find the compound interest on ₹10000 at 5% per annum for 2 years.
An article costing ₹300 is sold for ₹345. Find the profit percentage.
An article costing ₹540 is sold at a 25% profit. Find the selling price.
Find the average of the first five multiples of 9.
Two numbers are in the ratio 4 : 9 and their sum is 52. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 13. Each part = 52/13 = 4. Larger = 9 × 4 = 36.

questions.question: Find the value of √841.
If today is Saturday, what day will it be after 62 days?
questions.explanation: 62 mod 7 = 6; Saturday + 6 = Friday.

questions.question: Which letter is 4th to the right of the 5th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 5th letter = E; 5 + 4 = 9th letter = I.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (2, 8), (7, 343), (4, 64), (6, 217)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 6³ = 216, not 217.

questions.question: In a row of 38 students, Ravi is 20th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 38 − 20 + 1 = 19.

questions.question: Find the next term: 49, 64, 81, 100, 121, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 7²…11². Next is 12² = 144.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 7, 12, 19, 28, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 11, so 28 + 11 = 39.

questions.question: If MOON is coded as OQQP, how is LAMP coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 2. Applying the same to LAMP gives NCOR.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 3:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 3:00 the angle is 3 × 30° = 90°.
The relation is squaring: 4² = 16, so 4² = 16.

questions.question: A person walks 12 km East and then 16 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(12² + 16²) = √400 = 20 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 7 + 4 × 4.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 7 × 4 − 4 = 28 − 4 = 24.

questions.question: Find the next term: 2, 6, 18, 54, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×3: 54 × 3 = 162.

questions.question: Complete the series: C, F, I, L, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 3 places, so the next is O.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 12, 17, 7, 29
questions.explanation: 7, 17, 29 are prime numbers; 12 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 11th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 11th letter from the right is the 16th from the left = P.
The relation is cubing: 3³ = 27, so 6³ = 216.

questions.question: If today is Sunday, what day will it be after 47 days?
questions.explanation: 47 mod 7 = 5; Sunday + 5 = Friday.

questions.question: Which letter is 2nd to the right of the 5th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 5th letter = E; 5 + 2 = 7th letter = G.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (6, 216), (5, 123), (8, 512), (3, 27)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 5³ = 125, not 123.

questions.question: In a row of 43 students, Ravi is 21st from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 43 − 21 + 1 = 23.

questions.question: Find the next term: 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 5²…9². Next is 10² = 100.

questions.question: Find the next term: 2, 7, 14, 23, 34, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 13, so 34 + 13 = 47.

questions.question: If SUN is coded as WYR, how is FISH coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 4. Applying the same to FISH gives JMWL.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 2:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 2:00 the angle is 2 × 30° = 60°.
The relation is squaring: 10² = 100, so 4² = 16.
